text:
Come, draw nearer! The shady field,

the grim sky and the cold air

predispose the soul to sadness.

Come, rest your head on my shoulder;

like this, together, very close, my lord.


Let us speak of your love; of that dreamed

love! When desolate winter

reigns everywhere, and pale flee away

illusion and faith, how they warm,

the blessed memories of the past!


Come, draw nearer, my sweet lord...

and while with stubborn effort

the gray mist shakes its colossal crest,

may Chimera pour over us

the impalpable amphora of Dream.

translation.title: Come, Draw Nearer! The Shady Field
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the intimate winter address and the dreamlike final amphora.
